title: Preservation of the original injective counit comparison
statement: For the fixed abelian counit constructors [def-pc-abelian-counit-cocycle-comparisons] and an abelian injective resolution R of the underlying module sheaf F [def-sp-injective-resolutions], abelianInjectiveResolutionIso equals abelianExtSectionsIso followed by the original rightDerivedObjIsoOfResolution of R.ι and its injective-acyclicity proofs.

lean.statement:
theorem abelianInjectiveResolutionIso_eq_acyclic (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules)
    (R : InjectiveResolution
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)).obj F)) (p : ℕ) :
    abelianInjectiveResolutionIso X F R p = abelianExtSectionsIso X F p ≪≫
      (abelianSections X).rightDerivedObjIsoOfResolution R.ι
        (fun n ↦ Functor.rightAcyclic_of_injective (R.cocomplex.X n)) p
